title: Himalay Ki Godmein
desc: A newly qualified young doctor chooses to practise medicine in a small and remote Himalayan village which previously had no doctor or any medical facilities. His fiancée accompanies him but is appalled by the conditions and so leaves, forcing him to make a decision between staying to support the local people, or relocating to be with his love.

title: Azaad Desh Ke Ghulam
desc: When law student Bharti discovers that her father's wealth comes from illegal and immoral activities, she makes a deadly decision to escape that life and draws the attention of a plotting maternal uncle.
